domain: Professional Basketball Player Career and Draft Analytics
scenario:
A sports analytics company is developing an enterprise-level platform for analyzing the careers and draft performances of professional basketball players. This platform aims to provide comprehensive insights into player careers, including performance metrics, draft history, and financial outcomes. It will support teams, analysts, and scouts in evaluating player potential and career trajectories.

The platform will store detailed player data, such as shooting percentages, career statistics, and physical attributes, as well as draft information, including draft rounds, teams, and pick numbers. It will also track financial metrics like lifetime profits and mean season profits, offering a financial perspective on player careers.

Users will be able to explore player histories, compare draft outcomes with career achievements, and analyze the impact of college and high school backgrounds on professional success. The platform will feature advanced analytics tools, enabling users to generate reports, visualize career progressions, and simulate draft scenarios to support strategic decision-making in team management and player development.
